scripts.package:lambda: npm run build:lambda && zip -j function.zip dist/index.js
scripts.deploy:lambda: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && source .env; set +a; npm run package:lambda && AWS_PAGER="" aws lambda update-function-code --no-cli-pager --function-name "${LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME:?LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME is required}" --zip-file fileb://function.zip'
scripts.deploy:apigw: bash -lc 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && source .env; set +a; API_ID="${APIGW_API_ID:?APIGW_API_ID is required}"; STAGE="${APIGW_STAGE:-\$default}"; if [ "$(AWS_PAGER="" aws apigatewayv2 get-stage --no-cli-pager --api-id "$API_ID" --stage-name "$STAGE" --query AutoDeploy --output text)" = "True" ]; then echo "API Gateway stage $STAGE has AutoDeploy enabled; skipping create-deployment."; else AWS_PAGER="" aws apigatewayv2 create-deployment --no-cli-pager --api-id "$API_ID" --stage-name "$STAGE"; fi'
scripts.deploy:aws: npm run deploy:lambda && npm run deploy:apigw
